notes: MNEE terms state that the token is not designed to create returns for holders; reserve income is not recorded as a holder income right.
The EUB whitepaper states that holders receive no interest or other remuneration merely by holding EUB. Income earned on assets managed by the issuer is not recorded as a holder income right.
The USB whitepaper states that holders receive no interest or other remuneration merely by holding USB. Income earned on assets managed by the issuer is not recorded as a holder income right.

No native JPYR yield, rebase, reserve-income pass-through, or holder income right is established in the reviewed record. IZAKA-YA lending campaigns are external platform products and are not collapsed into JPYR token mechanics.
